purpose: PostgreSQL repository for media asset search, detail reads, uploaded asset persistence, variant persistence, metadata updates, archive, and bulk category assignment.
businessRules: Search/detail responses must include backend-built media URLs, version cache busting, dimensions, variants, category family, category product type, SKU, tags, SEO fields, and optimization statistics.
Admin-managed asset queries and mutations are restricted to media_assets.usage_type in category, product, or asset-manager; brand/system assets are not returned or mutated through DAM APIs.
Uploaded and replaced assets persist object keys plus s3-compatible provider/delivery metadata; StorefrontMediaUrlBuilder creates final public URLs.
Variant replacement deletes current variant rows before inserting the regenerated version set because the unique constraint is asset/variant/format scoped.
Nullable search filters must be cast to text in SQL before IS NULL/comparison checks so PostgreSQL can infer parameter types when admin filters are empty.
Original asset URLs and generated variant URLs are both built through StorefrontMediaUrlBuilder with the media asset version.
Archive is a soft operational removal through status/is_active, not a hard purge.
